items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 73:1
items.html: (To the question) The root of ZA, from the aspect of the ten Sefirot of AVI [upper Aba and Ima], you already know that from the aspect of the vessels it is Netzah, and from the aspect of the lights it is Tifferet, as above in Answer 146. However, from the aspect of the Partzufim, it has already been explained in the previous parts that it is the phase of the two lower thirds of the NH of AK, which at the time of the second restriction went out from the aspect of Atzilut to the phase of BYA; and afterward, through the ascent of the NHY of AK as MAN to AB SAG, and their receiving from there the new light that broke through to the Parsa, it returned and raised the two lower thirds of its NH from BYA to Atzilut, in the secret of a Vav and a point, which it bestowed upon Aba and Ima of the Nekudim, and Aba and Ima coupled upon them and brought them out in all the phases of Gadlut, which are the seven lower of the Nekudim that reigned and expanded down to the point of this world and broke. And afterward they returned and received correction through the ascent of the NHY to the HGT of AA, and through the couplings of Aba and Ima, which is the phase of the pregnancy of ZA, with which we are engaged in this part. Thus the root of ZA, from the aspect of the Partzufim, is not like its root from the aspect of the ten Sefirot, but rather it is from the phase of the two lower thirds of the NH of the Partzuf of the NHY of AK. And this has already been well explained in the previous parts. However, in truth, they have a close relation to one another, for even the ten Sefirot of the NHY of AK divide likewise into three thirds: KHB, HGT, NHY, in the manner that we explained above in the division of the NHY of AA of Atzilut. And as we explained above, that the essence of ZA is from the phase of the lower third of the Netzah of AA, and the Nukva is from the side of the lower third of the Hod of AA (see above, Answer 122), the same thing is likewise discerned in the NHY of AK: that the two lower thirds of the NH that went out to BYA at the time of the second restriction are the roots of ZON, with ZA in the lower third of Netzah, and the Nukva in the lower third of Hod. Thus the relations of AVI and the relations of the Partzufim always have an equal value.
